title: Drift Variation Autoencoder: Unifying Generation and Representation Learning through Conditional Posterior Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.25138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic masking, cropping, or modality removal makes deterministic reconstruction an incomplete target: one observation can admit many clean completions. This work takes the corresponding posterior $P(X\mid C)$ as the common statistical object for conditional generation and generatively sufficient representation learning. Drift Variation autoencoder trains a masked encoder $Z=E(C)$ and a conditional flow decoder with one clean-prediction Flow Matching loss. The analysis first decomposes the ideal conditional KL into generator approximation and the representation deficiency $I(X;C\mid Z)$. It then derives orthogonal risk decompositions for conditional Flow Matching. For an affine Gaussian path, the clean-prediction representation gap is zero if and only if $P(X\mid Z)=P(X\mid C)$. Thus the encoder-dependent excess clean-prediction risk induced by Flow Matching and the profiled ideal conditional KL have the same posterior-sufficient zer

translated_title: 漂移变分自编码器：通过条件后验流匹配统一生成与表征学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25138v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随机掩蔽、裁剪或模态移除使得确定性重建成为一个不完整的目标：一个观测可以对应多个干净的完成结果。本工作将相应的后验 $P(X\mid C)$ 作为条件生成和生成充分表征学习的共同统计对象。漂移变分自编码器训练一个掩蔽编码器 $Z=E(C)$ 和一个条件流解码器，使用单一干净预测流匹配损失。分析首先将理想条件KL散度分解为生成器近似和表征缺陷 $I(X;C\mid Z)$。然后推导出条件流匹配的正交风险分解。对于仿射高斯路径，当且仅当 $P(X\mid Z)=P(X\mid C)$ 时，干净预测表征间隙为零。因此，由流匹配引起的编码器依赖的过量干净预测风险与剖面理想条件KL散度具有相同的后验充分零点。
tldr: 该论文提出漂移变分自编码器，通过条件后验流匹配统一生成和表征学习，并证明在仿射高斯路径下，编码器依赖的干净预测风险与理想条件KL散度共享相同的后验充分零点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Drift Variation autoencoder that unifies generation and representation learning via conditional posterior flow matching, demonstrating that the encoder-dependent excess clean-prediction risk and the profiled ideal conditional KL share the same posterior-sufficient zero under affine Gaussian paths.
